ingest.idea_text: AI agent that chases unpaid invoices for independent consultants

plan.name: independent-accounting-practices
plan.description: Solo/small accounting and bookkeeping practices (2-10 staff) that invoice clients monthly
plan.why: Invoicing and collections are core recurring pain for billable-hours firms

plan.name: fractional-cfo-firms
plan.description: Fractional CFO / virtual controller firms handling many small clients
plan.why: Fractional operators own collections for many clients; leverage per saved hour is highest

plan.name: boutique-creative-agencies
plan.description: Boutique creative/marketing agencies with retainers and milestone invoicing
plan.why: Retainer billing disputes are common and visible in hiring signals (billing/invoice roles)

analyze.problem_statement: Independent accounting practices struggle to recover payment on overdue client invoices because following up manually is time-consuming and professionally awkward; the current workaround is sending reminder emails and making phone calls themselves, which costs billable hours diverted away from client work and risks damaging client relationships. Hypothesis: an AI agent that autonomously sends escalating, professionally toned payment chasers on behalf of the practice removes that time and relationship cost for independent accounting practices.
analyze.rationale: Pivot: pain signals are thin in 'independent-accounting-practices' (score 40). Re-cut segments around the hiring signals that do appear.
